svg.aria-label: Thirteen swatches in order from 0 to 12 semitones. 0: Perfect unison, #76848C; 1: Minor second, #C25562; 2: Major second, #C17D41; 3: Minor third, #8964A4; 4: Major third, #AB812D; 5: Perfect fourth, #4F816B; 6: Tritone, #5366A0; 7: Perfect fifth, #347B97; 8: Minor sixth, #A95E86; 9: Major sixth, #B47752; 10: Minor seventh, #367C79; 11: Major seventh, #7978B3; 12: Perfect octave, #89845D. The colours are an agreed artistic label for a pair of notes, not a property of sound.
svg.title: The thirteen interval identity colours

How to read this graphic: This is the key to
every colour in Week 2. Read across a row:
colour, number of semitones, then the
interval name. A colour is always printed
beside its name, so it never has to be
guessed, and it is attached to the pair of
notes, not to a voice. Compare with the live
